description: Open a ticket for a file from the user machine, content the service has not seen. Send the bytes in one raw HTTPS PUT to the returned url with exactly the returned headers, then call complete_upload. Limits: 2 GB, 30 minutes, 4096 px a side, 50 megapixels. An editor asset, the default purpose, needs its kind. Purpose video_reference stores a trend remake's source video: pass the ready ticket's video_reference.source_url to create_generation. Purpose actor turns a portrait photo of the user, or of someone who agreed to be cast, into an actor: it needs a name, takes jpg, png, webp or gif up to 10 MB and 4096 px a side, and the ready ticket carries actor.id for create_generation.
name: create_upload
title: Create upload
